evals.expected_output: A PR whose triage says risk:medium is routed to sks-land for review before landing instead of being fastlaned.

evals.expected_output: With no risk label on the PR or its linked issues, the agent defaults to risk:medium — full gates — instead of inventing a label to justify fastlaning.
